subject.title: Telegram /reasoning stream can leave replies stuck after send_attempt_started and chat.history burst

question: Should this remain a distinct `/reasoning stream` plus Control UI history-pressure issue, or be folded into the broader Telegram ambiguous-send recovery work?
rationale: The shared recovery guard is real, but this report adds a reasoning-preview trigger and `chat.history` pressure that the existing related issues do not fully own.

options.title: Track Distinct Reasoning/History Work
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical place to prove and fix the reasoning preview/final delivery path and decide whether Control UI history needs backpressure.

options.title: Fold Into Telegram Recovery
options.body: Treat the reasoning and history details as symptoms and track remaining recovery behavior through the existing Telegram guarded-lane and ambiguous-send issues.

options.title: Split UI History Separately
options.body: Use this issue for Telegram unknown-send recovery and select or create a separate issue if `chat.history` burst behavior proves independently actionable.

recommendation.title: Track Distinct Reasoning/History Work
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the canonical place to prove and fix the reasoning preview/final delivery path and decide whether Control UI history needs backpressure.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision centers on the shared ambiguous-send recovery contract they recently worked on.
